# UX & Mathematical Requirements Checklist: Weighted Average Pace Estimation & Goal Arrival Estimations Redesign

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality across mathematical pace weighting (`4:3:2:1`), visual hierarchy redesign (`Current Goal & Target` + `Weighted Average`), and accessibility/responsive constraints.
**Created**: 2026-11-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Mathematical Weighting & Display-Unit Reconciliation

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact weighting coefficients (`4:3:2:1` for `7D`, `14D`, `21D`, `28D`) explicitly quantified in the requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is dynamic weight re-normalization specified when fewer than 4 historical horizons are available (7–27 days of history)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Does the specification define whether individual horizon rates are rounded to 2 decimal places in the active display unit (`kg` or `lbs`) before computing the weighted average? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK004 Is the behavior specified when one or more horizons have positive (gaining) rates while others are in deficit? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Scenario 3, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Are the threshold and fallback state (`Stalled` vs `Projected`) explicitly defined when the weighted average rate is non-negative or within the noise deadband? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is the `> 52.0` weeks cap and badge behavior (`> 1 yr late`) specified for the `Weighted Average` row? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003]

## Visual Hierarchy, Layout & Accessibility

- [x] CHK007 Are the header and sub-header strings (`GOAL ARRIVAL ESTIMATIONS` and `Current Goal & Target`) and their ordering explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Is the exact summary text format for the primary `Weighted Average` row specified across `Projected`, `Capped (> 1 year)`, and `Stalled` states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK009 Does the specification define the visual separation (horizontal divider) between the primary `Weighted Average` estimation and the 4 historical breakdown rows (`7D`, `14D`, `21D`, `28D`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK010 Is backward compatibility specified for existing callers inspecting the 4 historical rows (`active.rows`) on `MultiHorizonForecastState.Active`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Are merged TalkBack accessibility `contentDescription` strings specified for the `Weighted Average` row? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §US3]
- [x] CHK012 Are viewport width (`360dp`) and font scaling (`1.3f`) non-overflow requirements measurably defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
